nom: TULA Instant De-Puff Eye Renewal Serum

avis.texte: I do like the de puff. I just ran out from a sampler kit that I bought at the store with different products. I had been looking for a new face cleanser and eye cream. Love theirs!!!!! I have puffiness sometimes in the morning and it really helps.

I have sensitive skin and have to be careful about the products I try, saw the reviews about stinging and burning, but I did not experience any of that. However, it did not depuff instantly, there is a minor improvement of puffiness after a couple hours. There are other offerings at Ulta that are more effective at a lower price point.
I have noticed a substantial improvement in under eye puffiness since using this product. I also enjoy the cool touch of the metal applicator. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: I was hoping it would work, but did not.
avis.texte: I have puffy eyes and have been looking for something to help "de-puff" other than cosmetic surgery. I was truly hoping this would at least help a bit, but it did not. I returned. At least it did not cause harm. Hope it works for others.

I was hesitant about this product, but I decided to splurge and try it out. Typically, I feel like I need to use an under eye concealer to feel confident. But after I started using the Instant De-Puff I haven't used anything! I am so impressed with this product- it firms, enhances, and moisturizes my skin!
Hands down, absolutely the best eye cream I've tried. It's so nice in the morning when my eyes are puffy & tired.
Love this eye cream. The applicator is great because it feels cooling which is nice and the cream isn't too heavy. I use it in the morning and it feels great!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: I would definitely keep buying this product. Within 10-15 minutes of application, the puffiness goes away!
My favorite under eye cream! The applicator makes it feel so good to put on!

Gave this serum 4 stars because of problems with the applicator. Have purchased this product several times and every time the dispenser seems to jam and stops dispensing the serum, twisted the top section off and a decent amount of product left. Definitely need to fix this problem.

This stuff, any of tula products make my skin sing and say good morning no matter what my night had in store, which can be a disaster lol. Can't find anything else that just makes my skin feel so good
As a mom of a toddler and an infant, I can testify that this stuff works! I go from Zombie-Eyed Mom to Awake Mom in an instant with this.
This product feels amazing under tired eyes! You have to be very careful when you pump it otherwise it squirts everywhere!

I love this serum, it gives the right amount of moisture without being greasy but also doesn't cause puffiness. Now for the bad part, the pump always breaks, so you will have to open up the tube and scoop out the ingredients instead. I've bought this 2x and had the same issue.
I was able to get 3 uses out of this product before the pump stopped working completely. There is more product in the tube but i cant get it out anymore.
Love this serum. I've been using it for at least 3-4 years. I never want to run out so it's on an auto delivery subscription!!

avis.titre: Great serum, applicator is even better
avis.texte: I love this applicator for the eye serum. it's cool to the touch and easy to use with the pump to save Serum. The metal applicator is designed very well. it decreases my puffiness daily. thank you
Love the applicator and is cooling. Great for puffy under eyes. A little goes a long way.
I love the eye renewal serum. It feels light and hydrates my skin and less puffiness.
I am amazed with this eye cream it is the only thing I have found to help with eye bags.
Love this eye renewal serum. I can feel it working. Really can see the difference around my eyes.
This is the best product I ordered in this shipment. It really does help to reduce the look of puffy and dark under eyes. I love the metal cooling applicator. Will buy another one when I run out.
So expensive yet I saw absolutely no results and unfortunately if anything my eyes were more puffy. Disappointed to say the least…

avis.titre: I use to always have puff
avis.texte: I use to always have puffy eyes. Using this regularly has totally gotten rid of the puffy eyes

avis.titre: I would not purchase this product again.
avis.texte: I really wanted to like this product. It came highly recommended by an Ulta sales person. The product did not work for me. It did not de-puff my under eye area considering the product is supposed to instantly de-puff, but it seemed to make my under eye area puffy. I tried it on two different days with the same results, more puffy.
Love this product!! The applicator is amazing cool on the skin, helps extra with those bags!
Amazing products! So many compliments on the improvement of my skin!
I love using this when I wake up with puffy eyes. I feel like they almost instantly lose their puffiness!
This is AMAZING :u1F970: it works instantly to de puff and cool the under eye. I don't think I can live without it :)
It's only been about a week, I love that the tool is cold all the time to spread on my under eye. Waiting for results to be noticed.
I have been using this eye serum for over two eeks now. I haven't seen a difference yet but will continue to use.
This product has TOTALLY changed my skin under my eyes! So hydrated, smooth skin to the touch. I will be buying this product for the rest of my life.
Love this product! After the first few uses you could really see a difference!
This product gave me an allergic reaction. I thought the burning feel was like a cooling effect but it burned my under eye skin area.

avis.titre: Honest review of eye renewal serum
avis.texte: As a new mom this product is a MUST. The consistency makes my under eyes feel amazing after use! It is such a good eye treatment and the cooling tip to apply helps your under eyes feel even better! I use this product at night time and the 24/7 eye balm in the morning and my new mom bags looking amazing because of these two products!!!
I love how this hydrates my skin. It doesn't leave it oily and I can wear my powder without any issues. I'm definitely ordering it again!

The cooling effect is real! This has become such an important part of my eye care routine. When I first started using this product it was almost stinging but that was because my eyes were super puffy when I first started. But that told me that it was actually working! Makes the appearance of my dark circles go away within 24 hours.

This makes my eyes feel so fresh and dewy. It brightens the under eye area as well. I have absolutely no regrets in buying this and will purchase again. The consistency is very smooth and creamy but not oily or overwhelming. Love it1

Thought I would try this to calm down the under-eye puffiness and make my dark circles diminish. They are my only skin problem at 64, and I will try anything to make these circles go away. I tried it for the entire product, about 8 weeks, every day. Nope. Did nothing. Complete waste of money.
I've tried quite a few eye serums but I'm so glad I decided to try this one.
I love Tula's products but this depuff eye serum irritates my eyes and doesn't depuff
Feels good, but after 3 months, doesn't seem to do anything for under eye puffiness.

I've been using this for about a month and am seeing no changes. While others love the applicator, I find it not as easy to apply. The cooling of the metal feels nice, but not easy to spread and apply. After reading the reviews I was hopeful that it would help with my dark undereye but i have seen no change. There is no smell, it's a nice texture, but no changes.
Seemed to be fine at first until I used it for several wks. Started drying the skin under my eyes. Have not had this happen with any other Tula product.
Great cream for the eye area! Goes on cool and is great skincare for morning and evening use.
What a find! I do not look like a 'bag' lady mid day anymore. This is with me on the go!
I like the eye cream and applicator. I don't notice any changes yet but seems like a good cream.

I got the cooling and brightening eye balm as part of a skincare package. I love the way it feels on my skin in the morning. It really feels cooling and I have found it minimizes my puffy eyes when I wake up. I was totally obsessed until I realized it leaves a sheer tint when it dries. That must be the "brightening" aspect. It is subtle but it looks almost like highlighter makeup under the eyes. Just not the effect I was going for. So I tend to only use a little bit of it BECAUSE of the shimmer.
Love this product in the morning especially if you are feeling tired.

avis.titre: It burned the first layer of my skin
avis.texte: I got this two weeks ago to test out the product since I was told it's for all skin types. I do not have sensitive skin and a few days ago the product started to burn a bit, I left it alone thinking it was normal till yesterday night where it burned the first layer skin off under my eye. It is incredibly itchy and has a burning sensation. I as well had bought the mini set for my significant other and they do have sensitive skin but it as well ended up burning their skin

I have suffered with dark circles and puffy eyes my entire life I have tried so many products and try life a healthy life some days better than others I came across this line online and I wanted to give it a try. So far with this item I haven't noticed to much of a change but I have only been using it for about 3 weeks so I m going to continue to use and give this product a chance I would like to update my three stars at a later point

This product is amazing. The applicator is great and the combination of the serum, it cools the under eye and does work to depuff. I use it in the morning and at night and have noticed a difference. Will keep buying!
I put this in the fridge & in 30 - 45 minutes my under eye is not dark and no more puffyness I had a hair stylist suggest this brand she uses it too .

avis.titre: B U M M E D
avis.texte: I've been using this product every morning for the past month, and I'm not impressed. When applying the serum to my lower under eye, it begins to burn, not cool. I also have not seen a visible different in my dark circles and under eyes. Not worth the price

I got this as a gift for my bags/dark circles and I have been constantly using it day and night for about 3 weeks now and it has done wonders for under my eyes. They have gotten so much lighter and it is very light weight. The pump is kind of annoying because if you press too firmly it shoots out, but that is minor for how well this works.

I'm not one to give terrible reviews but I hate this product so much. I have dry skin, my eye lids were getting very dry since it is getting colder, and I wanted to try a new eye cream. I was originally using cerave but I ran out and wanted to give it a try since it had great reviews. Ran over to my local ulta and bought it. Instantly, after application, my under eyes and eye lids had a burning sensation. Didn't know if it was normal but I continued to use it throughout the week. My eyelids never felt any less dry than they were originally, and if anything, they were getting irritated. I've been waking up every morning with swollen eyes and now I have a burn irritation on my under eyes. I stopped using it a week ago but the product just made my eyes so much worse and have yet to feel and look better. I have sensitive skin, so I wouldn't recommend if you have sensitive skin. I also am unsure if I can return it because I thought I was going to love it so I threw out the box and the receipt. If I can be refunded that would be incredible. It is not a cheap product.

The minute I first put this on my eyes I saw results. I have used ao many products trying to find something that would help with my dark circles and puffy eyes. This has been a wonderful product. I have recommended it to so many of my friends!!
Since I have been using the serum I have seen significant difference sound my eyes; lines have lessened and my eyes are brighter smells wonderful
Smells great. Cooling effect is nice! Over all skincare feels great
Doesn't do what it says it does, feels good on my eyes but doesn't remove puffiness
The cooling effect it has when you put it on is so nice! Part of my everyday skincare routine!
So far I've used this product as directed and have not seen any results. I don't get the tightening feeling and the puffiness does not go away. So sad, going to return it.
Worked great with the sample. But if you get sick it didn't get rid of all the puffiness.

avis.titre: Great Product, Not So Great Pump
avis.texte: I have chronically puffy eyes in the morning. This product works great and I like the cooling effect of the metal applicator. Tula really needs to do something about the pump, though. If I'm not careful, I end up "shooting" product on my counter and mirror. It's a pricey product, especially when you consider how much is wasted.
I bought this in a store. It never fails….I try so hard to barely press the pump Dow and when I do it ends up shooting more on the mirror or walls. So much has been wasted.

avis.titre: If you have severe bags you need this!
avis.texte: I have really big bags u see my eyes. Bad. Dark circles I can cover with concealer but bags are impossible. This is the first product that diminishes my bags! I'm shocked!! The cooling metal applicator feels so good too. If you have bags that you can never get to go away try this!

Ingenious application method—pumps up through the applicator. The metal application tip feels cool on the under eye area. I'm less clear so far on benefits of the serum itself but it feels lovely to apply.
I haven't noticed an improvement with wrinkles, puffiness or dark circles.

I started using this and have noticed my undereye circles look a bit less pronounced. I've never had that experience with other eye creams- I'm always a skeptic. On a day-to-day basis I haven't noticed a massive difference, but this serum really made an impact on a particularly early morning when I noticed I had extra bags under my eyes. After using the serum they were gone. My eye area definitely feels more hydrated and healthy. The cool metal applicator is a plus.

I love this product! It instantly tightens up under the eyes. I use it in the morning & by the time I brush my teeth & do my hair, any bags under my eyes are pretty much gone. I haven't noticed much difference in dark circles though. It's pretty pricey, but I haven't found another product that helps with bags like this does. One bit of advice, sometimes the hole where the product comes out can get clogged. Because this is so pricey you don't want to lose a drop! Hold your other hand over it when you push down so that if it is clogged, it doesn't go shooting everywhere & you lose some product. This way it just hits your hand & you can still use it :)

I really wanted to like this product/brand but I wasn't impressed. The applicator gets clogged with product pretty easily so I ended up shooting my ceiling with serum almost every time. If anything I got a good laugh out of using this! I expected better results, too and it just fell short.

I have very sensitive eyes and i started using this product for a about a week now. i definitely feel like my under eyes are not as dark. i've been using nightly... not sure if i would purchase again for the price but would consider if i couldn't find a dupe. the applicator with push button is very convenient for making the product go a long way.
Can't say there's much improvement in the wrinkle area, however skin around the eye is definitely moisturized, and it works like a charm at reducing puffiness around the eye, including eyelids.

I love skincare and Im very knowledgeable with ingredients and such and have tried a lot of products. First of all the applicator is cooling and makes putting on eye cream soothing. I love that its not a jar for sanitary reasons and prolonging the efficacy of the ingredients. This is not super thick nor super thing and feels nice on. Honestly anyone can have reactions to any ingredient at any time so I cant give too much review on the long term use of this product but my initial experience is great. Eye products are formulated for the delicate eye area so they are important but you cant have expectations that its going to remove all puffiness and dark circles. While these products help, they aren't a miracle. Dedication to a healthy diet and consistency with skincare is a must in order to see a difference. I will continue to use this with my routine unless I get a reaction.
I like how it feels but I really haven't noticed reduced puffiness under my eyes
I love the cool feeling when I put this on! I will be ordering again!
Been using Tula for three years and haven't found anything better including Plexaderm that I used for a year for my eyes .
I love the cooling effect it has on my skin. I do believe it lightens the color under my eyes as well. Overall I will continue to use and look forward to even greater results.
The feel is great but I've been using it now for 3 weeks and I see no difference
Not working as I thought it would. We will see after 2 weeks of use

avis.titre: Best eye cream I have ever used
avis.texte: I just turned 30 and I have really bad puffy under eye bags I have tried so many products from rretinal creams to different serums nothing has worked for me I got this to try it and I am in love I have bought it twice and will keep buying it it doesn't make my bags dissappear completely but it almost does it makes my eyes feel so moisturized and cool I love the metal applicator tip and the way it feels.
This serum is awesome. The cooking tip helps with swelling and I'm noticing less fine lines

avis.titre: Best eye cream for dark circles
avis.texte: I have had dark circles/puffiness all my life and this is one of the first creams that has actually helped
I love the cooling effect; it feels like a tiny massage. I enjoy using it when I first wake up to treat any puffiness and bring a little life back into my eyes.

I would say this is worth a try if you are looking for something new and different. it works fairly well but I didn't feel like it blended all that well. I've had it for about 6 months and the dispenser rome and won't dispense any more product. It's frustrating because I could take it off but that kind of defeats the purpose.
The cooking effect really helps with the puffy circles under my eye and it feels good! I reapply several times a day for a little pick me up!
It worked immediately. But lasted only like 3 hours. Took the crow's feet away and the 11 away too. Like it says temporary. 3hours for m

I went into Ulta to purchase another product for puffiness under my eyes in the morning. The sales associated talked me into buying this. While the cool metal applicator feels good, it does nothing for my puffiness. I plan to keep this and use at night until gone and buy my original product for the mornings. I will not buy this again though.
